name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 6 visits over 54 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 42 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2026-01-16, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.67 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
